notes.title: Henry Halfhead is OUT NOW! 👀✨
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3][p][/p][h3]The day has finally arrived! [b]Henry Halfhead is here! 💜[/b]👃💜[/h3][p][/p][p]After several years of scripting, creating, testing, and bug-fixing, we couldn’t be more excited to share the full story of our wonderful Halfhead with you all.
[/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/Tnhae9LMfC4"]https://youtu.be/Tnhae9LMfC4[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Here’s what awaits you in the game:[/h3][list][*][p][b]300+[/b] objects to transform into, from loaves of bread to paper planes.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]heartfelt story[/b] about life’s little joys and oddities.[/p][/*][*][p]Play alone or with a friend in the [b]local co-op mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles, surprises, and plenty of reasons to experiment.[/p][/*][*][p]And of course, a few hidden secrets (have fun trying to find [b]Bing Bong[/b] who is visiting from [b]Peak[/b]).[/p][/*][/list][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/23c8e49625b9b7816330e65c6379df7277bb58b8.png"][/img][/p][p] 

And for those jamming out to the music, [b]the OST is available to purchase[/b] here on Steam, with all of the revenue going straight to the musician Lucien Guy Montandon:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942680/Henry_Halfhead_Soundtrack/?curator_clanid=43807042"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]A big thank you[/b] to everyone who supported us throughout development! Making Henry Halfhead has been a weird, wonderful adventure, and it wouldn’t have been the same without such a kind and curious community along for the ride.[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/2d86c96bdba5ef75d048750a588b39d952062893.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We would be most grateful if you help us spread the word about Henry Halfhead. [/h3][p][/p][h3]Here’s how you can help:[/h3][list][*][p]Write a review on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Tell your favorite content creators about Henry[/p][/*][*][p]Share our launch post on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/lululu.games/post/3lyxfdrb7mc2e"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DOqiBMbjeAO/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@lululuentertainment/video/7550675093693762838"]TikTok[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/lululu.games/post/3lyxfdrb7mc2e"]X[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]For those who share your favorite moments, clips, and screenshots online, feel free to tag us so we can enjoy it too![/p][list][*][p]Bluesky: ‪[url="https://bsky.app/profile/lululu.games"]@lululu.games‬[/url][/p][/*][*][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@lululuentertainment"]@lululuentertainment[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Instagram: [url="https://instagram.com/lululuentertainment"]@lululuentertainment[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy"]Discord[/url]
[/p][/*][/list][p]If you come across any bugs or simply want to tell us how you liked the game, head over to our [url="https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy"]Discord [/url]or the Steam forums and let us know.
[/p][p][b]Thank you again for being part of this journey.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy and don’t forget to be yourselves,[/p][p]- Aaron, Tim, Leander and Jan
Lululu Entertainment [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/a68cfbfbf0f0f1a2498f5fc8a97b5ad78691ecdd.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Henry Halfhead launches Sept. 16th 2025
notes.content:
[h3]After several years of work, we’re excited to announce that we have a launch date for Henry Halfhead: [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]📅 September 16th 2025[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Tell your friends, family, and help us spread the news.[/p][p]Very soon you can dive into the 250+ playable objects and experience Henry’s life story.[/p][p][/p][p][b]To celebrate, we have a brand new trailer 🎬📺👀[/b][/p][previewyoutube="1MxkEmWdS4I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has joined us on this journey so far and we cannot wait for you to jump into the complete game in a few weeks. [/p][p][/p][p]See you soon,
[/p][p]- Aaron, Tim, Leander and Jan[/p][p]Lululu Entertainment[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.15
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone who played the demo so far! It has been wonderful to read your feedback in the reviews, the forums and on Discord 😊[/p][p][/p][p]This is a small update for the demo. [/p][p]Most notably, this patch should fix the demo getting flagged by some antivirus programs by removing the reported files (which are of a plugin which we no longer use).[/p][p][/p][p]As a small treat we've added some stylish sunglasses to the level. They're a bit big for baby Henry but they look super cool! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/e98734594cf022e7690bc9cea0f6551612acd1a4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]List of changes:[/p][list][*][p]Removed unused plugin which triggered some antivirus[/p][/*][*][p]Added fancy sunglasses to the level[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hand full of new narrator comments[/p][/*][*][p]Excluded settings from being synced over Steam Cloud Save (usually undesirable)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera control with mouse on Linux[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level loading screen flickers on Linux[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed debug input icons displaying when no controller is connected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the door to the demo-ending would not appear when loading gamesave[/p][/*][*][p]Various other tweaks and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: - Excluded settings from being synced over Steam Cloud Save (usually undesirable)
- Fixed camera control with mouse on Linux
- Fixed level loading screen flickers on Linux
- Fixed debug input icons displaying when no controller is connected
- Fixed bug where the door to the demo-ending would not appear when loading gamesave
- Various other tweaks and bug fixes

tags.feature: - Added fancy sunglasses to the level
- Added a hand full of new narrator comments

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey you all[/h3]

[h3]We're beyond excited to announce that the demo is available now![/h3]

In the demo you will:

[*] 🍎Possess [b]50+ everyday objects[/b]
[*] 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play alone or in the [b]local co-op mode![/b]
[*] 👶 Start Henry’s[b] life story[/b] as a baby!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=h3GpYMe1r1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]We are very excited for you to meet Henry![/h3]

We'd love to hear your feedback on Discord:
https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy

Or in a review on the demo page!

Thank you so much
👁️ 👃 👁️ 💜

- Aaron, Tim, Leander and Jan
Lululu Entertainment
